scope: First affected-only SCI and ZHEN semantic review of the complete repaired Q1 and Q7 display answers in zh and en. This is not a new blind preauthor solution, a repeated review of the other six answers, or a whole-card approval.

original_review.criterion_policy: Inherit the original questions, original d613 scientific assumptions, both localized findings and their countercases verbatim by binding. Do not tighten nonblocking clarity notes into new failures or relax the original domain to avoid either defect.

SCI: Answer the unrestricted original request to state refraction laws, using the inherited stationary ordinary-positive-index, homogeneous isotropic transparent-media, fixed-frequency geometrical-optics domain and a propagating transmitted ray when one exists.
Retain coplanarity, both angles measured from the interface normal, the same-frequency product-form Snell law, and the distinction from reflection.

Qualify the opposite-sides statement to oblique incidence and explicitly include normal incidence, when both geometrical ray segments lie on the normal. Do not remove normal incidence from the question or require an undefined sine ratio.
Review the complete three-line answer in both languages, not only the inserted clause.
ZHEN: Preserve the original task and equivalent conceptual meaning in the unchanged zh and en prompts.
Pair oblique incidence with normal incidence, opposite sides with lying on the normal, and retain equivalent coplanarity, normal-angle, fixed-frequency, Snell and reflection terminology throughout.

SCI: Answer the unrestricted request for convenient lens-construction rays under the inherited centered ideal thin-lens, same-surrounding-medium, paraxial geometrical-optics domain, without inventing a source lens type, object position or drawing.
Keep the parallel-to-axis, object-focus-to-parallel and optical-center rules, distinguishing converging and diverging cases as the full answer already does.

State the second rule for the incident supporting line through the object-side focus, expressly allowing its backward extension; actual passage through that point before the lens must not be required.

Admit the original symbolic inside-focus countercase: the focus behind a real emitting object is reached by a backward construction extension, not by the actual incoming segment. Supporting lines also apply to virtual-object constructions.

Retain two independent rays, real outgoing intersections versus virtual backward intersections, and the warning that coincident axial lines are not independent. Keep d613's auxiliary focal-plane and diverging-focus wording notes nonblocking.
Review the complete seven-line answer in both languages, not only the second ray rule.
ZHEN: Preserve the original general construction-ray task in both unchanged prompts.

Pair the Chinese line containing the incident ray with the English supporting line, and the Chinese backward extension with the English backward extension, without making an extension a physical light path.
Preserve equivalence of both lens-type qualifications, focus side, central ray, independent rays, real/virtual intersections and axial-degeneracy warning.

mandatory_delta_binding: Verify the four supplied full SHA-256 pins, both complete freeze manifests, the original-author freeze and the exact original-question and RAW bindings before issuing a report.

In each locale, reconstruct the complete repaired answer-file bytes from the frozen original-author bytes by only the two reported, uniquely located JSON-encoded prose substitutions. Require whole-buffer equality with the repaired file.

Require recursive structural differences to be exactly /answers/0/displayAnswer and /answers/6/displayAnswer per locale; byte-identical complementary file spans prove unchanged formatting and every other field.

Require whole exercise-template files to be byte-identical, and complete embedded original-source snapshots to equal the bound original exercises; compare exact source-snapshot serialization bytes as well.

Require the original ordered mathematical-span sequence for every answer in both locales to be unchanged. Require the preserved 28-span author KaTeX PASS receipt; do not rerun KaTeX, LaTeX or native commands.

Bind whole answer objects and display strings for Q2,Q3,Q4,Q5,Q6,Q8 and inherit their d613 SCI/ZHEN PASS decisions only if every preservation check passes. Perform no fresh semantic review of those six.

composition.rule: Issue effective written SCI PASS and ZHEN PASS only if both affected questions pass in both languages and every exact-byte preservation gate passes; otherwise retain a bounded FAIL/HOLD without author repair.
